name: Lei
source:
Lei is a Dark Lord affiliated with the Kayblis Faction.

Prior to becoming a Dark Lord, Lei was a Human man known as Lei Gatthon. Born during the GL Era, a time remembered as the most horrific in the history of The Continent, Lei was one of the few humans in possession of the raw power necessary to survive during the period without fear. Through a combination of a naturally exceptional talent for combat and a staggering level of tenacity, he was able to successfully fend off every group of Monsters that attempted to attack him, eventually growing strong enough to take on several hundred at once. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Lei]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
